description: This file defines the ConditionalHelper class used for handling conditional formatting formulas within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for writing XLS files. It manages parsing and processing of conditional formatting formulas or values and converts them to token representations for later use.

classes.name: ConditionalHelper
classes.description: A helper class for processing conditional formatting conditions in XLS files, including parsing formulas and handling condition values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with a parser object.

methods.name: processCondition
methods.description: Processes a condition value or formula for a specified cell range, converting it into tokens for XLS formatting.

methods.name: tokens
methods.description: Returns the token representation of the processed condition.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the token representation.
